title: A Call Under the Moon
content:
The room remained silent.

Neither Siddu nor Yashwanth spoke for several moments.

Finally...

Yashwanth looked at his friend and quietly asked,

"Siddu..."

"If you ever meet Sneha again..."

"Will you love her again?"

The question lingered in the air.

Siddu didn't answer.

He simply lowered his eyes.

His silence spoke louder than any words ever could.

Yashwanth looked at him for a long moment.

He understood.

Some questions didn't have answers...

At least, not yet.

Without saying another word...

He quietly walked out of the room.

________________________________________

As he stepped into the hallway...

Yashwanth couldn't stop thinking about Siddu.

"He came all the way from France..."

"He fought for my love..."

"And yet..."

"He's carrying so much pain inside himself."

A determined smile slowly appeared on his face.

"Just as Siddu stood beside me..."

"I'll stand beside him."

"No matter what."

He thought for a while.

Then...

An idea crossed his mind.

"If Sneha comes to the wedding..."

"Maybe..."

"The two of them can finally meet."

His eyes suddenly fell on Siddu's phone, which had been left on the table.

He hesitated for a moment.

"Forgive me, Siddu..."

"I'm only doing this because I want to help you."

He gently picked up the phone, searched for Sneha's contact, carefully noted down her number, and placed the phone back exactly where it had been.

Returning to his room...

He dialled the number.

After a few rings...

The call was answered.

"Hello?"

"Sneha?"

"This is Yashwanth."

"Oh!"

"Yashwanth!"

"How are you?"

"I'm doing well."

"I actually called to invite you."

"My wedding has been fixed."

"I'd really like you to come."

A warm smile appeared on Sneha's face.

"I'm so happy for you."

"Congratulations."

"I'll definitely—"

She suddenly stopped.

A thought crossed her mind.

Carefully...

She asked,

"Did Siddu ask you to invite me?"

Yashwanth hesitated.

Then he decided to tell her the truth.

"No..."

"He doesn't know I'm calling."

"I just..."

"I wanted to help both of you meet again."

Silence.

Sneha slowly closed her eyes.

A faint smile appeared on her lips.

But it carried sadness.

"I'm sorry, Yashwanth."

"I can't come."

Yashwanth looked confused.

"Why?"

She took a deep breath.

"If I come there..."

"And Siddu refuses to even talk to me..."

"I don't think I'll be able to bear it."

Her voice trembled.

"So..."

"If Siddu calls me himself..."

"I'll come."

"But if he doesn't..."

"I won't."

"Please..."

"Try to understand."

Yashwanth remained speechless.

He didn't know what to say.

After a few moments...

He quietly ended the call.

________________________________________

After the call...

Sneha slowly lowered her phone.

A painful smile appeared on her face.

"So..."

"He still doesn't want to see me..."

"That's why he never called..."

The thought alone was enough to shatter her heart.

Unable to remain inside her room...

She stepped outside.

Night had already embraced the city.

The moon shone brightly across the clear sky.

A cool breeze gently brushed against her face.

Without thinking...

She walked into a nearby park.

The place was peaceful.

She quietly sat on an empty bench.

Her eyes drifted toward the glowing moon.

"So much has changed..."

She whispered softly.

Just then...

Her phone vibrated.

She didn't even look at the caller's name.

Absentmindedly...

She answered.

"Hello..."

"Who is this?"

For a brief moment...

Only silence came from the other side.

Then...

A familiar voice finally spoke.

"Hello..."

"This is..."

The voice paused for a brief second.

Sneha frowned.

Something about that voice felt strangely familiar.

Her heartbeat quickened.

Then...

The voice completed the sentence.

"...Siddhartha."

Sneha's eyes widened.

Her fingers tightened around the phone.

"S... Siddu...?"
